name: Electronic Office
old_description: Simplify payments, maximize savings, and get local support for your business.
about:
Electronic Office operates from West Des Moines, Iowa, as a second-generation family-owned business. Current owner Erik Anderson grew up in the company, which was founded by his predecessor, and now leads a team that includes General Manager Kirsten Ingersoll and Account Manager Megan Farley. The firm has built its reputation on local, personalized service for businesses across Iowa and neighboring states.

The company supplies point-of-sale (POS) systems, payment processing solutions, mobile payment platforms, and scheduling tools. Rather than manufacturing hardware, Electronic Office partners with multiple payment vendors to configure and support integrated systems that handle inventory management, sales analytics, customer engagement, and field invoicing. Its offerings are tailored to each client, with no standard facility or production metrics disclosed.

Customers span restaurants and bars, retail stores, contractors, and specialty shops such as bookstores, boutiques, gift shops, pet stores, flower shops, thrift stores, liquor stores, and jewelry stores. The company also serves local markets in Cedar Rapids, Des Moines, Iowa City, Kansas City, and Omaha.

Electronic Office emphasizes its Iowa roots as a differentiator, promoting transparent pricing with no hidden fees, 24/7 technical support, and customized integrations that adapt as businesses grow. The mission centers on simplifying payment processes so owners can focus on serving customers.
